title: i think… because…
subtitle: an opinion with a reason is easy to say

steps.text: an opinion doesn't have to be big or right. it's just what you think.
adding "because" lets people see why. it also helps you find out why.

steps.prompt: someone asks which movie to watch. try each answer on:
lines: i think the comedy, because i could use a laugh tonight.
steps.reply: all real answers. the last one gives people a little more of you.

steps.text: low stakes. is breakfast for dinner better than breakfast?

ideas: pancakes at night feel like a treat.
morning food belongs in the morning.
good food is good any time.

steps.text: an opinion with a reason is easy to say, and easy to hear.
next time someone asks what you'd prefer, give one small opinion with a "because".

grounding.idea: a clearer sense of who you are is linked to wellbeing
